chapters.location: Oxford library, desert training arena, first labyrinth
chapters.coreMechanic: Combat and alchemy lessons, then a labyrinth
chapters.storyBeats: In Oxford, Tilda finds the legend of the Shariman and concludes that the changes in the scorpion constellation signal the fulfilment of a foretold destiny. In the desert Farhat trains under Wings. Egokhan allies with Rashid and they plan to draw Farhat into a labyrinth where his parents will be held prisoner. Dolunai urges her son to begin a long journey to reassemble the Shariman and save the world from Egokhan. (Order of these scenes within the episode is confirmed in the episode check.)

spec.cutscenesAndUnlocks: Wings's introduction; Dolunai's request; the villains' plan cutaway. Unlocks the sword combo, light meter and Heal potion.

chapters.coreMechanic: Cover-up stealth with an awareness meter
chapters.storyBeats: Oxford University is in a grave scientific crisis because Tilda has been away so long. Miss Keyhole, Tilda's dreadful tutor, is sent to persuade her to return. She reaches the friends in a dusty desert village and, through a mistake, unwittingly takes possession of the two Shariman crystals Farhat had retrieved. Wings's soft side saves the day and the crystals return to Farhat. Miss Keyhole never realises the wild events that happened around her.

chapters.setPiece: Egokhan's maze guardian and Dolunai's voice
chapters.storyBeats: Rashid kidnaps Tilda and brings her to Petroglobe Palace in the Emirates. To rescue her, Farhat uses one of Wings's powerful potions to turn into Rashid. It works perfectly, but Egokhan destroys the antidote. Farhat is imprisoned in Rashid's form and takes on Rashid's own wicked personality. Tilda and the others do all they can, tracking him into the depths of Egokhan's mazes. In the end, his mother Dolunai's sweet voice revives his true soul and breaks the spell.

Farhat then climbs an ancient pyramid to retrieve the fourth fragment, but the pyramid has Egokhan's features and swallows him.

chapters.storyBeats: The seven pieces of the crystal are united and the Shariman shines. Farhat prepares to face Egokhan, but the demon makes a diversion by sealing Nigel in the shaft of an English mine. Tilda finds out and urges her friends to save him. Before leaving, Farhat hides the Shariman in the desert sand. In England the friends reach Nigel in the coal mine while Egokhan tries to stop them with red-hot magma, and Wings comes to the rescue. Back in the desert, Farhat finds the crystal gone; Tilda realises a bird has stolen it. Farhat's Shadow chases the thief while the others escape Egokhan, who is driven by Rashid, in a spectacular way.

chapters.location: The great maze, epilogue in the Emirates
chapters.coreMechanic: Callback gauntlet, non-lethal parent encounter, final boss
chapters.storyBeats: Farhat and his companions head for a great maze to face Egokhan one last time. After a fierce battle Farhat is the last one standing against his enemy, who has prepared a cruel final challenge. Egokhan has charmed Farhat's parents and made them guardians of the labyrinth, ready to die to block their son. Farhat will not hurt them, but Yassir and Dolunai fall lifeless. Overcome by grief, he hurls himself at Egokhan. The clash is tremendous and Farhat finally takes the Shariman from the place where Egokhan removed it seven thousand years ago. His parents come back to life, Rashid is defeated, arrested and sent to jail, and the Shariman proves to be the heart and fuel source of an ancient machine that brings life to the desert with clean, everlasting energy.

objectives.text: Free the parents with light, not force
